page.notes: Greek entries in the Calculis, Canes and Carcere lines are only partly legible; the Greek is given as far as it can be read, with [?] where unsure. The Casariæ heading is uncertain. The bottom of the column is cut off, so the last entry continues on the next part. Doubtful readings: the Greek after "pro" and the first Greek word after "Dentes" are not legible enough to copy letter by letter. "βεβρωμένοι" is a best reading and is not certain. The line "Decollare, de marsupio di-ctum" and the following "sum-prum" line are read from a small, slightly blurred print. The final line "Defpe" is a fragment at the bottom of the scan.
